title: Nsil1-Msp1 RAD-digest Detailed Protocol
author: Ben JG Sutherland
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.w95fh86
materials: Ligated DNA stored at 4°C until use.
Pool all four PCR library replicates.

steps.title: Prepare Adapter Stocks
steps.instruction: Suspend lyophilized single stranded adapters to a final stock concentration of 100µM in 1X EB.

substeps.instruction: Combine Adapter 1 top and bottom in plate format (one well per individual adapter).
Combine Adapter 2 top and bottom in strip tubes.

steps.title: Prepare Double Stranded Adapters
steps.instruction: Make 100µL of 10µM double stranded adapter for both Adapter 1 and Adapter 2 using gH20, 10X AB, top adapter, and bottom adapter.

steps.title: Anneal Adapter 1
steps.instruction: Place the top and bottom Adapter 1 mixture onto the Thermocycler and run the 'RAD Anneal' program (01:12:00).

steps.title: Verify and Dilute Adapter 1
steps.instruction: Check the annealed adapters with the Qubit, then dilute Adapter 1 from 10µM to 3µM using gH20.

steps.title: Store Adapter 2
steps.instruction: Keep Adapter 2 at 10µM and store at 4°C.

steps.title: Normalize Adapter 1
steps.instruction: Normalize Adapter 1 to 2.2ng/µL (0.1µM) and store at 4°C.

steps.title: Create Working Adapter Stock
steps.instruction: Create 100µL of 'Working Adapter Stock' (final concentration 0.02µM) containing Normalized Adapter 1 (2.2ng/µL), 10µM Adapter 2, and 1X AB.

substeps.instruction: Seal plate, vortex, and spin down.
Store at 4°C until use.

steps.title: Prepare Genomic DNA
steps.instruction: Quantify genomic DNA via gel electrophoresis and Qubit to ensure samples contain between 20ng/µL and 150ng/µL.

substeps.instruction: Create a 30µL aliquot of 20ng/µL genomic DNA using AE Buffer as diluent.
Store at 4°C until used.

steps.title: Perform Restriction Digest
steps.instruction: Prepare a Restriction Master Mix per reaction containing gH20, Nsil1, Msp1, and 10µL Cutsmart Buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 10µL of Restriction Master Mix to each well.
Add 10µL of 20ng/µL genomic DNA sample to the mix.
Seal plate and run the 'RAD-digest' PCR program (01:09:00).

steps.title: Perform Ligation
steps.instruction: Prepare a Ligation Master Mix per reaction containing gH20, T4 DNA Ligase Reaction Buffer, and T4 DNA Ligase.

substeps.instruction: Add 5µL of Adapter Working Stock to the 20µL restriction digest product.
Add 15µL of Ligation Master Mix to the 25µL mixture.
Seal plate and run the 'RAD-ligation' PCR program (02:25:00).

steps.title: Pool and Clean-up Samples
steps.instruction: Pool 5µL of each sample into a single tube and perform a column clean-up using the QIAquick PCR Purification Kit.

substeps.instruction: Calculate pooled sample volume and add 5 volumes of PB.
Transfer 600µL to filter column and spin at 17,900g for 1 minute; discard flow-through.
Add second 600µL aliquot to column and spin at 17,900g for 1 minute; discard flow-through.
Add 750µL of PE and spin at 17,900g for 1 minute; discard flow-through.
Spin empty column at 17,900g for 1 minute; discard flow-through.
Transfer column to new epi tube, add 60µL of EB to the center of the membrane, and spin at 17,900g for 1 minute.
Keep flow-through and store at 4°C until size selection.

steps.title: Prepare for Pippin Prep
steps.instruction: Prepare the sample for size selection.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 30µL of sample to a clean epi tube.
Add 10µL of Pippin Loading Solution (stored at 4°C).

steps.title: Configure Pippin Prep
steps.instruction: Initialize and program the Pippin Prep instrument.

substeps.instruction: Turn on the Pippin Prep and perform an optical calibration.
Navigate to the main menu and select the most recent run from the drop down menu.
In the Protocol Editor, alter lane numbers and set 'BP Start' to 200 and 'BP End' to 350bp.
Select 'USE INTERNAL STANDARDS' and save the protocol with the current date.

steps.title: Load Pippin Prep Cassette
steps.instruction: Prepare the cassette and load samples.

substeps.instruction: Dislodge bubbles behind elution wells and fill low reservoirs with electrophoresis buffer.
Remove 40µL of buffer from the elution well and refill with fresh buffer; cover wells with tape.
Remove 40µL of electrophoresis buffer from the sample well and replace with 40µL of sample; repeat for remaining samples.
Perform continuity test and press 'Start'.

steps.title: Retrieve Size-Selected Samples
steps.instruction: Collect the processed samples and clean the cassette.

substeps.instruction: Remove tape from elution wells and retrieve 40µL of sample per well.
Remove cassette from optical nest and cover all wells with aluminum tape.
Fill rinse cassette with ddH20, place in the cassette, and close lid.
Incubate probes for one minute, discard water, and allow cassette to dry before storing.

steps.title: Perform RAD Amplification
steps.instruction: Prepare an Amplification Master Mix per reaction containing gH20, Taq 2X Master Mix, Ion Primer Forward, and Ion Primer Reverse.

substeps.instruction: Add 5µL of size selected sample to 20µL aliquot of PCR Master Mix (run each multiplexed sample in quadruplicate).
Run the 'RAD-amplification' program (00:56:00).

steps.title: Final Clean-up and Aliquoting
steps.instruction: Perform a final column clean-up using the QIAquick PCR Purification Kit.

substeps.instruction: Calculate pooled sample volume and add 5 volumes of PB.
Transfer 600µL to filter column and spin at 17,900g for 1 minute; discard flow-through.
Add 750µL of PE and spin at 17,900g for 1 minute; discard flow-through.
Spin empty column at 17,900g for 1 minute; discard flow-through.
Transfer column to new epi tube, add 50µL of EB to the center of the membrane, and spin at 17,900g for 1 minute.
Keep flow-through.
Create a 30µL aliquot to 200pM sample for processing on the Ion Chef.

steps.title: Long-term Storage
steps.instruction: Store all plates and sample pools at -20°C.
